scope: Resolve implementation ambiguities without changing the registered candidate grids, selectors, thresholds, absolute package gates, or licensed wording.

mean_site1_score.currency: KL(M0O1N||M0M1N)/KL(M0O1N||M0N1N), with the matching M0N1N copy baseline
mean_site1_score.use: nondeployable scored control only; cannot select a true or shuffle program

causal_omission.full_oracle: validated K4608 full-native executable under frozen selected T0, with zero original MLP0/1/2 calls
causal_omission.omission: set the post-live-state correction coefficient c_j=p_j-(mo B)_j to zero before physical reconstruction; do not set p_j to zero
causal_omission.inference: validation-only reporting weights; cannot alter either selector

causal_direction_prediction.predictor: the validation-frozen true-site1 A-family representative selected by the registered family representative rule
causal_direction_prediction.error_series: mean squared target-consistent coefficient error of the A representative, (c_hat_j-c_j)^2 because A is the registered z-only-c interface, on the identical 12288 T0 validation coefficient-capture positions
causal_direction_prediction.statistic: ordinary Spearman correlation using average ranks for ties
causal_direction_prediction.gate: point estimate greater than zero; diagnostic only

family_bank.original_qqn_bank: Retain the preregistered same-family QQN combinations as descriptive response comparisons only because nonselected site1 representatives were trained under selected T0, not their same-family site0 parent.
parent_consistent_reports: site0 A-E representatives as X0NN against NNN
site1 A-E representatives as selected-T0 plus X1N against selected-T0-N1-N
family_bank.claim_guardrail: No state/objective/grammar mechanism-identification claim may be made from the context-confounded QQN bank. The registered selected-package admission gates are unchanged.

final_frequency_collateral.assignment: recompute compiler_fit_v21 token counts at target columns 65:257 and bucketize compiler_final_v21 targets at the same positions with right=True and boundaries [1,2,4,8,16,32,64,128]
final_frequency_collateral.bins: all nine prespecified bins; report every nonempty bin and mark an empty bin unevaluable rather than silently dropping it
final_frequency_collateral.estimand: token-weighted candidate CE minus matched-background CE
final_frequency_collateral.gate: maximum worsening across all prespecified nonempty bin/background cells <=0.01; any empty bin makes the frequency-collateral claim unevaluable

inference.unit: source-document cluster with row-weighted estimands and one shared resample across every arm
inference.interval: torch.quantile float64 linear interpolation at 0.025 and 0.975
inference.ratio_thresholds: R0, R1, and Rjoint <=0.50 are point-estimate gates with positive denominators; <=0.25 is the stronger reported rung
inference.holm: one-sided paired document-bootstrap p=(1+#(replicate contrast<=0))/(B+1), Holm step-down familywise alpha 0.05
inference.nonlinear: recompute maxima, ratios, and margins within every bootstrap draw
inference.sparse_collateral: Use the same fixed 2000 source-document draws without rejection or resampling. For a globally nonempty copy/frequency support, retain the point estimate but mark its interval unevaluable, report the exact zero-support draw count, and fail the corresponding collateral conjunct if any registered draw has zero denominator. A globally empty frequency bin remains empty_unevaluable. Sparse collateral can therefore make the package authoritative-negative but cannot abort the one-shot final transaction.

separate_reports: serialized index count and encoded bits
price_currency.wording: P_T<=P_S licenses only no-greater registered standalone real-valued tensor count

order: authority-none final attempt before final deserialization
one final role load and one fixed evaluation
outcome_transaction.failure: After final forwarding begins, preserve all artifacts, write no outcome authority, and require a new committed namespace for retry.
